title: The Last Mixtape
author: Rafael Underhill
blurb: Beatrix Eastwick, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
